note: [L] does the rearrangement discretely, with $\sum_{a<n\le b} g(n)(F(n)-F(n-1))$ in place of $\int_a^b h(u)F'(u)\,du$ and no floor/integral chain; $g$ is assumed non-increasing instead of the running maximum $h$.

snippet.text:
have key : ∀ k, a ≤ k → k ≤ b →
      ∑ n ∈ Icc a k, f n * g n ≤ g a * F a + ∑ n ∈ Ioc a k, g n * (F n - F (n - 1)) -
        g k * (F k - ∑ m ∈ Icc a k, f m) := by
    intro k hak hkb
    induction k, hak using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp; linarith [mul_comm (f a) (g a)]
    | succ k hak ih =>
      have ih := ih (by omega)
      rw [sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), sum_Ioc_succ_top hak,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      have hgk := hg k hak (by omega)
      have hSk := hS k hak (by omega)
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgk (sub_nonneg.2 hSk)]

proof_context.conclusion: Discrete summation by parts by induction: $\sum_{a\le n\le k} f(n)g(n)\le g(a)F(a)+\sum_{a<n\le k} g(n)(F(n)-F(n-1)) - g(k)(F(k)-S(k))$, the discrete counterpart of turning $\sum F(n)(h(n)-h(n+1))$ into $h(a)F(a)-h(b)F(b)+\int h F'$.
